map.由 PWM 脉冲宽度求舵机转角。: Find the servo angle from the PWM pulse width.
map.📖 查看「角度 = (脉宽 − 最小) / (最大 − 最小) × 180° 使: 📖 View Guide: "Angle = (pulse width - minimum) / (maximum - minimum) x 180°"
map.1500µs（500–2500 范围）→ 90°。: 1500 µs over a 500 to 2500 range gives 90°.
map.舵机脉宽映射角度。: Map the servo pulse width to an angle.
map.θ=(2000−500)/2000×180=135°，随脉宽线性增大。: θ = (2000 - 500)/2000 x 180 = 135°, growing linearly with the pulse width.
map.常见 500μs=0°、1500μs=90°、2500μs=180°（50Hz）: Typically 500 μs means 0°, 1500 μs means 90° and 2500 μs means 180° at 50 Hz.
